I have all the evidence I need. Here is my report.

## (a) What a producer of U2 actually owes — plain mathematics

`IsDivRepClassify` is defined at `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean:90-112`. Instantiated at `F₀ := U i j` (a `DivFamZar` over the chart ring `R_Z`) and `v := ChartMap i j = divCarveChartToDivScheme … i j`, it unfolds to:

> For every `k`-algebra `T` that is an `R_Z`-algebra in a compatible tower, every **certified** divisor family `G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T π g` whose divisor class equals the restriction of `U i j` to `T`, and every pair-chart index `(i', j')` with a framing `w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i' j' →ₐ[k] T` such that `w` pulls the tautological windows back to the coordinate images of `ε(G)₁`, `ε(G)₂` under the DD-4 boundary bases `b₁`, `b₂`:
>
> `Spec(algebraMap R_Z T) ≫ ChartMap i j ≫ divSchemeι = Spec(w) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i' j'`

Because `divCarveChartToDivScheme_divSchemeι` (`Picard/DivSchemeAtlasFactor.lean:370`) rewrites the LHS to `Spec(algebraMap R_Z T) ≫ Spec(divCarveChartMk i j) ≫ pairChartMap … i j`, and because the W2 converse `map_pairTautFst_eq_of_specMap_pairChartMap_eq` / `…Snd…` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarSep.lean:59`, `:76`) plus the W2 forward `specMap_pairChartMap_eq_of_map_pairTaut_eq` (`Picard/GrassmannianPairCompare.lean:120`) make the conclusion **equivalent** to an equality of Grassmannian points, the obligation is, in plain mathematics:

> **(U2′)** For every tower test `T` over `R_Z` and every certified `G/T` representing `U i j`, the base-changed universal tautological pair over `T`, i.e. `Grassmannian.map (algebraMap R_Z T ∘ divCarveChartMk i j) (pairTautFst/Snd)`, **is** the coordinate image of `ε(G)` — the pair `(ε₁, ε₂)` computed from `G`'s local equations.

That is: *ε of the universal family at the universal point is the tautological pair, after arbitrary base change and for every certified representative*.

**Where a global `IsCertified` over `R_Z` is needed: nowhere in the statement.** This is the sharpest thing I can say and it confirms your suspicion at the level of the *clause*. The clause's own hypothesis data is `G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T π g` — a certificate over the **tower test T**, supplied by the consumer, not by the producer. The producer never has to exhibit a certificate over `R_Z`. Two independent confirmations from the tree:

- `eq_of_isDivRepClassify` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarSep.lean:352`) states in its own docstring, at `:349`: "No certificate over the whole chart ring and no DDR9-U ε-identity is consumed." It is kernel-clean (probed: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`).
- `DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarKit.lean:433`) *produces* certified representatives + framings over `Localization.Away`-carriers from a bare `DivFamZar`, with no global certificate.

## (b) Is the G-4 global-certificate gate stale? **Yes for the object `U i j`; No for the ε-identity itself.** The framing conflates two things.

The roadmap sentence you quoted ("U2 is gated on `ThetaGeneratorSeed.certifiedFamily` demanding a global `IsCertified` over R_Z") is **stale as applied to producing `U i j`, and still accurate as applied to proving the ε-equation**. Splitting them:

**Stale half (the object).** `U i j : DivFamZar C R_Z π g` genuinely does not need a global certificate, and the relaxation is landed and kernel-clean:

- `ThetaGeneratorSeed.divFamZar_of_forall_away_certified` — `Picard/DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean:132`. Away-local certificates over a span-`⊤` family give the `DivFamZar` class. Axioms `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- `ThetaGeneratorSeed.isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_away_certified` — `Picard/DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:141`, and the maximally consumable `…of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation` at `:161`, which only asks, **at each prime `p`**, for *some* `r ∉ p` and *some* adaptation of the pulled system over `Localization.Away r` carrying a certificate. Its own docstring at `:158-160` calls the old gate out by name: "Contrast with the old gate `divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning`, which demanded a certificate for the canonically extracted adaptation over the whole chart ring; that shape forces a globally valid no-leak hypothesis, **which is false**."
- The seed side is *unconditionally* there over `R_Z`, which I did not expect and which the roadmap undersells. `PointwiseAchiever.highWindowPointwiseGeneratorSeed` and `isGenerator_highWindowPointwiseGeneratorSeed` (`Picard/DivSchemeHighWindowPointwiseGenerator.lean:76`, `:89`) give a `ThetaGeneratorSeed` over `R_Z` at the window `divUniversalSeedK` **together with `IsGenerator`**, gated only on `hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi` — and that side condition is not a real gate, since `windowBound ≤ 0` forces `g = 0` (`genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos`, `RiemannRoch/WindowFieldTransport.lean`). Both are kernel-clean (probed). This is strictly stronger than the roadmap's "the seed itself exists (`DivSchemeSeedUnivGen.lean:283`)": `seedUniv` at `:283` is a bare seed with **no** `IsGenerator`; the generator lives in the HighWindow lane instead.

**Not-stale half (the equation).** The only landed route from a seed to the ε-value is `ThetaGeneratorSeed.divFamEps_certifiedFamily` (`Picard/DivSchemeEps.lean:312`), via `divFamEps_mk_eq_of_le` (`:279`), and both take `hc : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified g` **over the ring in question**. So over the tower test `T`, `ε` can only be pinned where a certificate is available — and there the consumer supplies one (`G`), which is exactly why the clause is satisfiable. The gap is that no landed lemma converts "`DivFamZar` class, locally certified" into "ε is pinned" at the *class* level. So the honest verdict: **the gate is stale as a blocker on constructing `U i j`, and it has been misdescribed as a blocker on U2. The real residual obligation is a different statement than either the roadmap or the relaxation docstring says** — see (c) item 1.

`divRepClassifyZar` is defined for every locally certified class over every affine test,
and `isDivRepClassify_unique` makes it the *unique* morphism satisfying the characterizing
clause.  So a morphism satisfies the clause for `F₀` exactly when it **is** the classifier
of `F₀`.

Forward is uniqueness against `divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify`; backward is a rewrite.
Mentioning no chart family and no universal point, this is what turns the DDR9-U
ε-identity into an equation between two already-existing morphisms of schemes (see
`DivRepChartFamily.isChartClause_iff_forall_classify_eq`). -/
theorem isDivRepClassify_iff_divRepClassifyZar_left_eq {S : Type u} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k S] (F₀ : DivFamZar C S pi g)
    (v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
      DivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
        (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)) :
    IsDivRepClassify hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 F₀ v ↔
      (divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F₀).left = v := by
  refine ⟨fun hv => ?_, fun hv => ?_⟩
  · exact isDivRepClassify_unique hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 F₀
      (divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 F₀) hv
  · rw [← hv]
    exact divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 F₀

`IsChartClause U` holds exactly when, for each pair chart `(i, j)`, the backward
